title: The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon and the most powerful planeswalker alive, former ruler of Madara, whose power and memory are waning since the Mending; he is scheming on Grixis and Alara.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: An empire once ruled by Nicol Bolas as god-emperor.

entities.name: Umezawa line
entities.description: A line that Nicol Bolas was the scourge of.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A dark kami who is a longtime enemy of Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Elder Dragons
entities.description: Five dragons who survived an ancient war of the dragons; Nicol Bolas is the mightiest.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event that sealed the time rifts, saving the Multiverse but diffusing Bolas's spark and limiting his power.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who adopted Bant as her new home plane.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker drawn to the predatory dragon-realm of Jund.

entities.name: Ajani Vengeant
entities.description: A planeswalker born on Naya; a changed version of a character seen before.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane broken into five shards, setting of the Shards of Alara block and of Bolas's plans.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara that is Nicol Bolas's temporary abode.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara adopted by Elspeth as her new home.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A predatory dragon-realm shard of Alara.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara where Tezzeret is native.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara where Ajani was born.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane where the first five planeswalker cards appeared.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A figure shown on the cropped early cover of Alara Unbroken.

events.summary: Bolas recognizes his memory and power slipping away because of the Mending.
events.quote: Yet that healing event has effectively put limits on Bolas's capacity for power

events.summary: Bolas forms a multi-part plan to restore his glory and gain unmatched power, with little time left.
events.quote: He's got a plan to head off this brutal decay, and to not only restore his former glory, but to assume total, unmatched power in the multiverse.

events.summary: Bolas is pursuing early stages of his plan and may be discovered by forces of Alara and other planeswalkers.
events.quote: But since he has to move more quickly now, his plans may be discovered.

relations.quote: One of the five Elders who survived an ancient war of the dragons, and mightiest of the five.
Mortal minds are just as malleable in his hands as they were when he was the god-emperor of Madara.
the perfect emblem for his temporary abode, the shard of Grixis
